_doc: The parts AgentGlim ships for a SuperAgent's plans folder. The Harness page (/harness, app/harness.mjs) reads this file and checks each path live. An empty plans harness still runs the dashboard; these tools only answer its Status, Watcher and queue controls. Run `npm run scaffold-harness` to create the run folder and link them into <run>/bin. Paths use the same {plans} {run} {agentglim} {data} ~ tokens as app/settings.defaults.json.

pieces.title: Status card writer
pieces.why: Answers the Status card's refresh request with the SuperAgent's own words, then marks the request answered.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.

pieces.title: Watcher chat reply
pieces.why: Writes the SuperAgent's reply and structured asks to the Control page, then marks the inbox message answered.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.

pieces.title: Done-claim checker
pieces.why: Checks the items you marked done and confirms or reopens them with evidence.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.

pieces.title: Harness setting writer
pieces.why: Applies Jev tie-margin and notification changes queued from the Harness page.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.

pieces.title: Disk guard for one job
pieces.why: Runs one heavy disk job at idle priority and pauses it while the disk is busy.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.

pieces.title: Watcher queue listener
pieces.why: Prints pending audit, status, chat and done-check requests for the SuperAgent and keeps the queue heartbeat fresh.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.

pieces.title: Jev model and effort router
pieces.why: Picks a model and reasoning effort for a job from the rules file.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.

pieces.title: Worker launcher
pieces.why: Starts one worker on codex, claude, pi or opencode with a prompt file, tracks it with jobs-track and writes pid, rc and its last message to an outdir.
pieces.next: Run npm run scaffold-harness to link it into the run folder.
